Package dao

Class ReservationDAO

java.lang.Object
dao.ReservationDAO
public class ReservationDAO extends Object
Data Access Object (DAO) for all Reservation and suite-availability operations in the MIRAGE system.

This class handles booking new reservations (with overlap checking and automatic cost calculation), cancellation, and various read queries used by the reservation and checkout screens.

Responsibilities

  • Insert reservations with date-overlap validation (insertReservation(Reservation))
  • Cancel reservations and cascade-delete their experiences (cancelReservation(int))
  • Retrieve all reservations (getAllReservations())
  • Retrieve reservations by guest (getReservationByGuest(int))
  • Retrieve available suites with next-available dates (getAvailableSuites())
  • Look up the guest ID for a reservation (getGuestIdByReservation(int))
  • Look up the total room cost for a reservation (getReservationTotalCost(int))

  • Method Details

    • insertReservation

      public void insertReservation(Reservation r) throws SQLException
      Inserts a new reservation into the reservation table after validating that the requested suite is not already booked for the specified date range.

      Logic flow

      1. Overlap check: Queries for any non-cancelled reservation on the same suite whose date range intersects the requested window. If one is found, a SQLException is thrown immediately.
      2. Cost calculation: Computes the total room cost as nights × nightly_rate by calling getNightlyRate(int).
      3. Insert: Writes the reservation row with the computed cost. The database assigns the reservation_id and sets status = 'confirmed' via its default constraint.

      SQL executed:

      
   -- Overlap check
   SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservation
   WHERE suite_id = ? AND status != 'cancelled'
     AND check_in < ? AND check_out > ?

   -- Insert
   INSERT INTO reservation (guest_id, suite_id, check_in, check_out, total_cost)
   VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
      Parameters:
      r - the Reservation to persist; must have valid guestId, suiteId, checkIn, and checkOut
      Throws:
      SQLException - if the suite is already booked for those dates, or if any other database error occurs

    • cancelReservation

      public void cancelReservation(int reservationId) throws SQLException
      Cancels a reservation by deleting its experience line items first, then deleting the reservation record itself.

      The deletion order is intentional: reservation_experience has a foreign key referencing reservation, so child rows must be removed before the parent row can be deleted.

      Note: These two deletes are not wrapped in an explicit transaction. If the second delete fails, orphaned reservation_experience rows will have already been removed.

      SQL executed:

      
   DELETE FROM reservation_experience WHERE reservation_id = ?
   DELETE FROM reservation WHERE reservation_id = ?
      Parameters:
      reservationId - the ID of the reservation to cancel; must be positive
      Throws:
      SQLException - if the reservation does not exist or a database error occurs

      public List<Reservation> getAllReservations() throws SQLException
      Retrieves all reservation records from the database.

      Each row is mapped to a Reservation instance with reservationId, status, and totalCost populated in addition to the constructor fields.

    • getAvailableSuites

      public List<Suite> getAvailableSuites() throws SQLException
      Retrieves all suites along with their next-available date.

      For each suite, a subquery determines the latest check_out date among its active (non-cancelled) future reservations. If no such reservation exists, next_available is null, meaning the suite is free immediately.

      Results are ordered by hotel name, then suite number, to support the grouped display in the reservation screen's suite grid.

      SQL executed:

      
   SELECT s.suite_id, s.suite_number, s.hotel_id, s.class_id,
          h.name AS hotel_name,
          (SELECT MAX(r.check_out) FROM reservation r
           WHERE r.suite_id = s.suite_id
             AND r.status != 'cancelled'
             AND r.check_out >= GETDATE()) AS next_available
   FROM suite s
   INNER JOIN hotel h ON s.hotel_id = h.hotel_id
   ORDER BY h.name, s.suite_number
      Returns:
      a List of Suite objects, each enriched with hotelName and nextAvailable; empty if no suites exist
      Throws:
      SQLException - if a database error occurs during the query

    • getGuestIdByReservation

      public int getGuestIdByReservation(int reservationId) throws SQLException
      Looks up the guest ID associated with a given reservation.

      Used by CheckoutScreen to identify which guest's total_spend to update after adding an experience.

      SQL executed:

      
   SELECT guest_id FROM reservation WHERE reservation_id = ?
      Parameters:
      reservationId - the reservation to look up; must be positive and exist
      Returns:
      the guest_id linked to this reservation
      Throws:
      SQLException - if the reservation ID does not exist or a database error occurs

    • getReservationTotalCost

      public double getReservationTotalCost(int reservationId) throws SQLException
      Retrieves the total room cost stored for a given reservation.

      Used by CheckoutScreen to display the room charge line item in the guest folio.

      SQL executed:

      
   SELECT total_cost FROM reservation WHERE reservation_id = ?
      Parameters:
      reservationId - the reservation to look up; must be positive and exist
      Returns:
      the total room cost in USD
      Throws:
      SQLException - if the reservation ID does not exist or a database error occurs

    • getNightlyRate

      private double getNightlyRate(int suiteId) throws SQLException
      Retrieves the nightly rate for a given suite by joining through its suite class.

      This is a private helper called exclusively by insertReservation(Reservation) to compute the total room cost before persisting the reservation.

      SQL executed:

      
   SELECT sc.nightly_rate FROM suite s
   JOIN suite_class sc ON s.class_id = sc.class_id
   WHERE s.suite_id = ?
      Parameters:
      suiteId - the ID of the suite to look up; must be positive
      Returns:
      the nightly rate in USD, or 0.0 if the suite is not found
      Throws:
      SQLException - if a database error occurs during the query
